This is an opaque FLAT surface texture for application onto a 3D building: the texture MUST fill every pixel, perfectly front-on with NO perspective, NO isometric view, NO outside background or transparency, NO overall building silhouette.
Create a square 1024x1024 armor-surface texture. Broad mostly quiet irregular navy steel panels with thin recessed seams, 4-6 large angular subdivisions, one diagonal joint, a few small flush bolt heads at corners, subtle hand-painted edge highlights. Surface average brightness around dark slate blue #354357, readable but dark. No window, no door, no emissive light, no repetitive checker grid, no busy greebles, no deep holes. All panel lines stay coplanar, color variation is subdued. Uniform flat illumination, no spotlight gradient. It should read as clean anime background painting when seen close up.
